en.io: Input: optional --dry-run and .hyperflow/commits-queue/manifest.json. Output: queued-commit listing or a fast-forward result; on divergence, an error and manual recovery suggestions.
en.boundary: Limited to Hyperflow's recorded staging and user branches. It cannot resolve branch divergence automatically; on failure it preserves the staging branch and manifest. Missing staging branches may cause stale queue metadata to be cleared.
dependencies: Claude Code-compatible shell and file-reading tools
scenarios: Preview queued commits with a dry run.
Fast-forward queued staging commits onto the recorded user branch.
Recover when automatic end-of-chain flushing did not run.

zh.io: 输入：可选的 --dry-run 和 .hyperflow/commits-queue/manifest.json。输出：队列提交列表或快进合并结果；分支分叉时输出错误及人工恢复建议。
zh.boundary: 仅处理 Hyperflow 清单记录的暂存分支和用户分支；不能自动解决分叉。失败时保留暂存分支和清单；暂存分支缺失时可能清理失效的队列元数据。
dependencies: 兼容 Claude Code 的 Shell 与文件读取工具
scenarios: 通过 dry-run 预览排队的提交。
将暂存分支中的提交快进合并到清单记录的用户分支。
自动收尾未执行时恢复提交。
